text.en: Shoppers consistently praise the staff and owner Natalie for their warm welcome and practical guidance. Customers mention that the team takes time to discuss canine nutrition, offer tips on natural diets, and help select appropriate accessories for their animals. Pet owners value the attentive customer service and approachable manner during visits.

title.en: Quality natural treats and raw feeding

text.en: Reviewers appreciate the curated selection of raw pet food, natural treats, and specialised feeding solutions. Several customers note finding sturdy slow-feeder bowls that resolved rapid eating problems, alongside wholesome treats for dogs on sensitive diets. Dog owners report that purchases deliver dependable quality and noticeable dietary improvements.

title.en: Welcoming shop atmosphere and convenient parking

text.en: Pet owners highlight the pleasant layout of the Garforth shop where dogs are warmly invited to browse alongside their handlers. Reviewers note that visiting by car is straightforward with convenient parking situated right nearby. Customers also appreciate that shelves remain consistently stocked with requested dietary staples and pet accessories.

q.en: Does The Urban Pet Store allow dogs inside?

a.en: Yes, customers frequently bring their dogs into the shop, where pets are welcomed and offered fuss by staff.

q.en: Does the store stock raw pet food and natural treats?

a.en: Yes, the shop specialises in raw meat, natural chews, and healthy snacks for dogs and cats.

q.en: Can customers order products online for delivery or collection?

a.en: Yes, the store provides online ordering options alongside click and collect services for local pet owners.

q.en: Is car parking available near the Garforth store?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that convenient car parking is available near the premises on Main Street.
